function.arguments: {"command": "echo \"--- answer.txt ---\"; cat answer.txt; echo \"--- bytes ---\"; wc -c answer.txt; echo \"--- diff vs grep extract ---\"; diff <(grep -oP '(?<=TOKEN=).*' gen_out.txt) <(tr -d '\\n' < answer.txt) && echo MATCH; echo \"--- err file ---\"; wc -c gen_err.txt; echo \"--- tail of output (large) ---\"; tail -2 gen_out.txt | cut -c1-30"}
